auth: Invocation-owned Azure ManagedIdentityCredential and async bearer policy; never caller/SQL/Search token, never API-key downgrade. AZURE_CLIENT_ID optionally selects user-assigned identity.

dynamic_configuration: Load and close only generic MCP settings per invocation on the worker-thread path, including MCP_ENABLED and JSON MCP_TRUSTED_HOSTS. No Hosted republishing or 30-second refresh timer required for MCP activation; unrelated capability guards and refresh timers remain unchanged.
adoption_order: Parent configures dedicated invocation resource, caller role and generated endpoint before publishing generic MCP configuration. Server owns approved SQL access and Cosmos vectors.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding orchestrator and its configuration as a coordinated rollback; no checkpoint/data conversion and no automatic direct SQL fallback.
documentation_handoff: Azure/AI-Landing-Zones main: update NL2SQL selection, MCP resource auth/configuration and breaking direct SQL removal. Owned by the coordinated docs workspace, not this checkout.
source_policy_review_required: The unchanged annotation ratchet flags deletion of annotated nl2sql_tools, its execute_dax_query closure and ToolIdentity.dax_token within retained native.tools. This is intentional physical SQL symbol removal, not removal of annotations from surviving functions. No gate exception, checker change, typing-scope reduction or SQL stub is introduced.
release: Feature candidate only; no image, tag, release, Azure deployment or main merge.
